Name: Dino Pokemon Variants
Author: Necrofiend13
Description:
The eggs will hatch into new dinosaurs based off of Pokemon Sprites from HG/SS 4th generation. The sprite tilesheet images can be edited easily if you prefer a different appearance. 32x32 tiles.

Rough Egg - #567 Archeops. Produces eggs more often, takes least time to hatch. 
Hard Egg - #411 Bastiodon. Produces eggs less often, takes medium time to hatch. Eggs can produce extra Mayo
Heavy Egg - #248 Tyranitar. Produces eggs less often, takes medium time to hatch. Eggs can produce extra Mayo
Fragile Egg - #142 Aerodactyl. Produces eggs infrequently, takes a long time to hatch. Eggs can produce triple Mayo

The normal Dino egg is unchanged.

This mod also adjusts (increases) the sale price of all dinosaurs, so you could breed them for profit, if you choose to. As well as allowing Mayo qualities derived from all egg types (chicken, ostrich, void..etc), and qualities (Silver, Gold, Iridium). Also, Dino eggs have been added to Artifact Troves.
[b]It is highly recommended to also install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20266]Blue Eggs and Golden Mayo[/url] by 6480. Special thanks for the help with getting mayo machines working for this mod.
It is also suggested that, should your museum space become filled from displaying the eggs, you add a mod that also allows you to adjust the tilesheet of the musuem to create more space. This would only be relevant if you have added a lot of new artifacts to the base game. (Such as with SVE)[/b]

Suggestions, Feedback or bug reports are highly appreciated. Please refer to Nexus, or visit my [url=https://discord.gg/pN3JSQfr]Discord[/url] page (NecroCrab's Mods)
